name: stickies
description: Persistent sticky notes for Claude Code. You pin a note — a decision, a blocker, a todo — and it survives session resets, /clear, and closing the terminal. Next time you open Claude in that project, the notes that still matter are handed back to it automatically.
install:
# git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/dumbspacecookie/stickies
